from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque
\ndef components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = [(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    z=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=z[0]<h and 0<=z[1]<w and z not in seen and grid[z[0]][z[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(z); q.append(z)
            out.append((color,cells))
    return out
\ndef l_info(cells):
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    if H<2 or W<2:
        return None
    s=set(cells)
    # Ls can point in any of four directions. Allow a few pixels of thickness,
    # while rewarding components that occupy two perpendicular bounding sides.
    best=None
    for vr in (r0,r1):
        for hc in (c0,c1):
            v={(r,c) for r,c in s if c==hc}
            h={(r,c) for r,c in s if r==vr}
            corner=(vr,hc)
            union=v|h
            # score by proportion of cells on the two arms and coverage of arms
            arm_coverage=(len(v)+len(h)-1)/(H+W-1)
            purity=len(s & union)/len(s)
            score=0.65*arm_coverage+0.35*purity
            if best is None or score>best[0]:
                best=(score,(1 if vr==r0 else -1, 1 if hc==c0 else -1),corner,(H,W))
    score,orient,corner,shape=best
    return score,orient,corner,shape
\ndef transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in g) for v in set(v for row in g for v in row)}
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    comps=[]
    for color,cells in components(g):
        if color==bg: continue
        info=l_info(cells)
        if info:
            rr=[r for r,c in cells]; cc=[c for r,c in cells]
            touches=any(r==0 or r==h-1 or c==0 or c==w-1 for r,c in cells)
            comps.append({'color':color,'cells':cells,'info':info,'touches':touches,
                          'bbox':(min(rr),max(rr),min(cc),max(cc)),'n':len(cells)})
    if len(comps)<2:
        return g
    # The marker is usually the L-shaped component on the frame. In compact
    # instances it is the smaller L adjacent to a larger same-facing object.
    framed=[x for x in comps if x['touches']]
    if framed:
        anchor=max(framed,key=lambda x:(x['n'],x['info'][0]))
    else:
        # Prefer a small, clean L paired spatially with a larger L.
        anchor=min(comps,key=lambda x:(x['n'], -x['info'][0]))
    candidates=[x for x in comps if x is not anchor]
    # Prefer same-facing Ls; if no such object exists, allow the rotated form.
    same=[x for x in candidates if x['info'][1]==anchor['info'][1]]
    pool=same or candidates
    def dist(x):
        a=anchor['bbox']; b=x['bbox']
        dy=max(0,a[0]-b[1],b[0]-a[1]); dx=max(0,a[2]-b[3],b[2]-a[3])
        return dy+dx
    # Nearby prominent L component is the object to recolor.
    target=min(pool,key=lambda x:(dist(x), -x['n'], -x['info'][0]))
    for r,c in target['cells']:
        g[r][c]=anchor['color']
    return g
'''
p=programs/'task-a1b589ee.py'; p.write_text(code)
